## Variables

<a name="catalog"></a>catalog holds the copy of each catalog section, keyed by section name and then by the copy's name within the section.

```go
var catalog = readCatalog() //nolint:gochecknoglobals // Parsed once from embedded copy and read without mutation.
```

<a name="document"></a>document is the embedded copy catalog, in TOML.

```go

```

<a name="Text"></a>
## func Text

```go
func Text(key string) string
```

Text returns the copy for a key of the form "section.name". It panics when the catalog has no such key.

<a name="readCatalog"></a>
## func readCatalog

```go
func readCatalog() map[string]map[string]string
```

readCatalog decodes the embedded catalog. It panics when the catalog is malformed.
